_comment: Everything that identifies or monetizes the site lives here. Empty strings disable a feature. Rebuild (npm run build) after editing.
tagline: Instant answers to everyday money math
_domain_help: Your custom domain without https://, e.g. wagefigures.com (free as of 14 Nov 2026). Leave empty until you own one; the site still builds and works on GitHub Pages.
_github_help: Used only to compute the fallback URL (https://USER.github.io/REPO) when no domain is set.
_contact_help: Shown on the Contact page. AdSense reviewers look for a working contact method.
_searchConsole_help: Google Search Console > Add property > URL prefix > HTML tag method: paste only the content="..." value here, then deploy.
_bing_help: Bing Webmaster Tools > Add site > HTML meta tag: paste only the content value here (or import from Search Console instead).

adsense._help: Your AdSense publisher ID, format ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX. Ads and ads.txt are emitted only when this is set.
adsense._slots_help: Optional ad-unit slot IDs. Leave empty to use Auto Ads only (recommended for a start).

analytics._help: Optional Google Analytics 4 ID, format G-XXXXXXXXXX. Connecting GA4 to Search Console helps track what ranks.

affiliate._help: Optional call-to-action boxes shown on calculator pages. Fill in after you are accepted by an affiliate program. Keys are page families; 'default' is used when a family has no entry.
